description: This file defines the class DVarP, which calculates the population variance based on data in a database, following the Excel DVARP function. It focuses on variance calculation over filtered data.

classes.name: DVarP
classes.description: A class for calculating the population variance of a filtered database column, corresponding to the Excel DVARP function.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the variance of a population using the specified database, field, and criteria parameters. Returns an error if the field extraction fails.
